53. MAINTENANCE ALLOWANCE TO SEVERELY AFFECTED  PERSONS  
 
 
1. 
Gist of the Scheme 
Maintenance  allowance  is  given  at  the  rate  
of Rs.1,500/-  per  month  to  the  severely  affected 
persons who cannot be rehabilitated by any other 
assistance. The allowance is sent through “ECS” to 
their bank account directly from Treasury. 
 
 
2. 
Eligibility Criteria 
The percentage of disability should be more than
75%. Locomotor disabled persons who cannot be
rehabilitated through any other scheme. 
3. 
Whether   the prescribed 
application form is available 
Yes.  Prescribed format is available with District
Differently Abled Welfare Officers. 
4. 
Certificates to be furnished 
National Identity card for the differently abled, 
family card, Photo and Bank account details. 
5. 
Officer to whom the application 
is to be submitted 
District Differently Abled Welfare Officer 
6
.

addressed to
